texto.es: Cuentas que necesitas: llave de auto, cerradura de casa o un trabajo comercial.
texto.en: Tell them what you need: a car key, a home lock or a commercial job.

texto.es: El equipo revisa la llave, el fob o la cerradura en el taller propio, a la vista.
texto.en: The team checks the key, fob or lock right in the in-house workshop, in plain sight.

texto.es: Cortan y programan la llave o el fob con las máquinas del taller mientras esperas.

texto.es: Pruebas la llave o la cerradura ahí mismo antes de irte. Guarda el número para la próxima.
texto.en: You test the key or lock right there before you leave. Keep the number for next time.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según la marca del vehículo o el tipo de cerradura. Llama para un precio directo.

items.quote: Liberty locksmith was recommended to me to program a key fob for my car. I arrived at the shop and 3 men were working on a car out front. I went into the shop and their customer alert sound went off.

Superfast friendly service. I had, what I thought, was a huge problem with my deadbolt at home (all hardware removed except bolt still stuck in locked position in door and door frame). I stopped by the store to see if they could help me.
